label: banana__segatoka
explanation: Banana exhibits symptoms indicative of Segatoka. This phytopathological or entomological condition affects foliage and vascular tissue, potentially reducing photosynthetic capacity and crop yield.
symptoms: Yellow/chlorotic streaks parallel to leaf veins turning dark reddish-brown with grayish necrotic centers.
organic_remedy: Remove heavily spotted lower leaves and burn them outside the orchard. Spray bio-fungicide Pseudomonas fluorescens at 5 g/L.
chemical_treatment: Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (1 ml/L) or Carbendazim 50% WP (1 g/L) with sticker. Alternate with Mancozeb 75% WP.
preventative_measures: Ensure adequate field drainage to prevent water stagnation. Practice crop rotation with non-host species. Disinfect field pruning tools with 1% sodium hypochlorite between plants.
